python3 << 'EOF'
import math

# Calendar year interest-bearing debt for Series E and EE (in millions)
debt_1992 = 144724
debt_1993 = 158633
debt_1994 = 166731

# Annual average CPI-U values (from BLS)
cpi_1992 = 140.3
cpi_1993 = 144.5
cpi_1994 = 148.2

# Adjust to constant 1994 dollars
# Formula: Real Value = Nominal Value × (CPI_1994 / CPI_year)
adjusted_1992 = debt_1992 * (cpi_1994 / cpi_1992)
adjusted_1993 = debt_1993 * (cpi_1994 / cpi_1993)
adjusted_1994 = debt_1994 * (cpi_1994 / cpi_1994)  # This is just the original value

print("Inflation-adjusted values in constant 1994 dollars:")
print(f"1992: {adjusted_1992:.2f} million")
print(f"1993: {adjusted_1993:.2f} million")
print(f"1994: {adjusted_1994:.2f} million")

# Now calculate sample z-score for 1994 value
# Using sample standard deviation with n-1 (Bessel's correction)
values = [adjusted_1992, adjusted_1993, adjusted_1994]
n = len(values)
mean = sum(values) / n

# Sample standard deviation (n-1 in denominator)
variance = sum((x - mean) ** 2 for x in values) / (n - 1)
std_dev = math.sqrt(variance)

print(f"\nMean: {mean:.2f}")
print(f"Sample Std Dev (n-1): {std_dev:.2f}")

# Z-score for 1994
z_score = (adjusted_1994 - mean) / std_dev

print(f"\nSample z-score for 1994: {z_score:.2f}")
EOF
